FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.hint: If you don't find your answer, contact us directly on WhatsApp.

items.question: Are the courses certified?
items.answer: A private training certificate is issued at the end of each path. It is not MINEFOP approved at the moment — but the acquired skills are immediately applicable and valued on the local and international market (Upwork, Andela, freelance missions).

items.question: In-person or online format?
items.answer: Both options are available. In-person in Yaoundé for practical workshops, or 100% online via Google Meet. Course material is provided in PDF.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or bank transfer. Payment in 2 installments possible on request for courses above 50,000 FCFA.

items.question: Do I need basic computer skills?
items.answer: Each course clearly indicates its prerequisites. Some start from scratch (Office, HTML/CSS, AI in daily life). Others assume basic knowledge (React, Python ML). Contact us if you are in doubt.

items.question: Can in-house training be organized?
items.answer: Yes, with a flat rate for a group. This is particularly relevant for Cybersecurity, Power BI and AI courses for businesses.

items.question: What is the group size?
items.answer: 8 to 12 participants maximum to ensure personalized follow-up. Individual or pair sessions available on request.
